label: Recreate table AuthSession
summary: Recreates table AuthSession to apply schema changes: database/AuthSession/column:lastSeenAt

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

precheck.description: ensure temp table "_prisma_new_AuthSession" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

precheck.description: ensure table "AuthSession" has exactly the columns the rebuild copies or leaves out (createdAt, expiresAt, id, tokenHash, userId)
precheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('AuthSession')) = 5 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('AuthSession') WHERE name IN ('createdAt', 'expiresAt', 'id', 'tokenHash', 'userId')) = 5

execute.description: create new table "_prisma_new_AuthSession" with desired schema
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_AuthSession" (
  "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "lastSeenAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("tokenHash"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User" ("id")
)
